articles.headline: Amundsen scores twice as Crew beat Toronto for 5th win in last 6 games
articles.description: Malte Amundsen scored two goals. his first career multi-goal game in MLS, Gonzalo Tapia and Brooks Lennon each added a goal, and the Columbus Crew beat Toronto FC 4-1 on Saturday.

articles.headline: Nashville SC wins 1st MLS Supporters' Shield title, eyes points record
articles.description: Nashville SC clinched the 2026 MLS Supporters' Shield title after a 2-0 victory at CF Montréal on Saturday, winning the trophy for the first time in club history.
